status: focused R2 repair input pending independent review

axes.blender: X long; Y front(-) to rear(+); Z up
axes.gltf: exporter performs Z-up to Y-up conversion; audit exported bounds

ringTopology.meaning: Each pair is [normalized Y by station depth, Z]. Shelf pairs 2→3 and 5→6 are real horizontal/near-horizontal cross-section bands, not recessed face fans.

build.sideFaces: Bridge identical ring index i to i+1 modulo 11 for each adjacent station pair; preserve shared ring vertices.
build.endCaps: After all six bridges, create each end as an ordered ngon from its 11 ring vertices; triangulate through bmesh.ops.triangle_fill then bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals. Do not fan through an unshared centre vertex.
build.bluntEnds: Station0 keeps 1.30m upper shoulder continuation and 1.62m depth; station6 truncates at 0.78m/1.64m. End n-gons are noncoplanar only after triangulation; no flat prism inset or detached end piece.
build.facets: May split existing side quads only along their diagonal after Gate A; no centre fans, offsets, booleans, separate slabs, or primitives.

sourceThreeQuarter.highShoulder: upper shelf stations0-2 rises 1.30→1.60→1.46m, visibly above lower cap at stations3-6
sourceThreeQuarter.longLowerCap: lower shelf stations2-6 is a continuous 0.96→0.64m descending band with a visible front-facing transition from upper shelf

side.left: two shelf depths and the 1.60m shoulder must read as stepped planes, not one roof slope
side.right: 0.78m blunt cap and 1.64m body depth must remain substantial

frontRear.failure: generic equal prism ends or hidden/zero-width shelves

audits.bounds: all station extrema plus ring factors must be within X[-2.2,2.2],Y[-1.05,1.05],Z[0,1.60]
audits.ground: indices0 and10 of every ring exactly Z=0
audits.topology: one component; every edge two faces; outward normals after bmesh recalc; end cap closure
audits.contact: BVH pairs sharing vertices/edges are cap-adjacent and must be classified separately; any non-adjacent positive-volume overlap fails
